EmailTemplate.name: Notice to All Users: Case issues
EmailTemplate.subject: Salesforce Case Access Update
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Starting today, September 25, 2014, recruitment and marketing Salesforce users will have access to view cases.
Case read-only view will be available to these users on the contact page layout as a related list section towards the bottom of the page.
ASU Salesforce Support Team salesforce.support@asu.edu
